title: Descent of a counit-defined coefficient isomorphism through full embeddings
statement:
For $R=A,B$ let $\mathcal C_R,\mathcal D_R,\mathcal C'_R,\mathcal D'_R$ be categories (objects with Hom sets and associative unital composition), with functors $F_R:\mathcal C_R\to\mathcal D_R$, $I_R:\mathcal D_R\to\mathcal C_R$, $F'_R:\mathcal C'_R\to\mathcal D'_R$. Let $F_R\dashv I_R$ have counit $e_R$ [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection]. Let $S_{C,R}:\mathcal C_R\to\mathcal C'_R$ and $S_{D,R}:\mathcal D_R\to\mathcal D'_R$ be functors. Let coefficient functors be $T_C:\mathcal C_A\to\mathcal C_B$, $T_D:\mathcal D_A\to\mathcal D_B$, $T'_C:\mathcal C'_A\to\mathcal C'_B$, $T'_D:\mathcal D'_A\to\mathcal D'_B$, with natural isomorphisms $t_C:S_{C,B}T_C\xrightarrow{\sim}T'_CS_{C,A}$, $t_D:S_{D,B}T_D\xrightarrow{\sim}T'_DS_{D,A}$. Fix $M\in\mathcal D_A$, put $N=I_AM$ and $M_B=T_DM$. Let $\delta_{A,N}:S_{D,A}F_AN\to F'_AS_{C,A}N$ be a morphism. Let $\mathcal C^0_B\subseteq\mathcal C_B$ be a full subcategory containing $T_CN$ and $I_BM_B$, and let $\delta_{B,X}:S_{D,B}F_BX\to F'_BS_{C,B}X$ for $X\in\mathcal C^0_B$ be a family natural in $X\in\mathcal C^0_B$. Choose an object $Q_A\in\mathcal C'_A$. Let $\mathcal V_B$ be a full subcategory of $\mathcal D'_B$ containing $S_{D,B}M_B$ and $T'_DS_{D,A}M$, with their isomorphism $t_{D,M}$, and let $J_B:\mathcal V_B\to\mathcal C'_B$ be a functor. Suppose there are isomorphisms
$$\alpha_A:S_{C,A}N\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_A,\qquad
\alpha_B:S_{C,B}I_BM_B\xrightarrow{\sim}J_BS_{D,B}M_B,$$
and a family $E_{B,Q}:F'_BJ_BQ\to Q$, natural for the isomorphism $t_{D,M}:S_{D,B}M_B\to T'_DS_{D,A}M$, together with a morphism $E_A:F'_AQ_A\to S_{D,A}M$, such that
$$E_A F'_A(\alpha_A)\delta_{A,N}=S_{D,A}(e_{A,M}),\quad
E_{B,S_{D,B}M_B}F'_B(\alpha_B)\delta_{B,I_BM_B}=S_{D,B}(e_{B,M_B}).$$
Let $c:T_DF_AN\xrightarrow{\sim}F_BT_CN$ be an isomorphism, and let $c'_Q:T'_DF'_AQ\to F'_BT'_CQ$ be a family natural for $\alpha_A:S_{C,A}N\to Q_A$, with invertible components at those two objects. Assume
$$c'_{S_{C,A}N}T'_D(\delta_{A,N})t_{D,F_AN}
=F'_B(t_{C,N})\delta_{B,T_CN}S_{D,B}(c).$$
Suppose $b':T'_CQ_A\xrightarrow{\sim}J_BT'_DS_{D,A}M$ satisfies
$$E_{B,T'_DS_{D,A}M}F'_B(b')=T'_D(E_A)(c'_{Q_A})^{-1}.$$
Assume that $S_{C,B}$ is fully faithful on a full subcategory containing $T_CN$ and $I_BM_B$, that $S_{D,B}$ is injective on $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D_B}(F_BT_CN,M_B)$, and that $\delta_{A,N},\delta_{B,T_CN},\delta_{B,I_BM_B}$ are isomorphisms. Then there is a unique isomorphism $b:T_CN\xrightarrow{\sim}I_BM_B$ whose image under $S_{C,B}$ is
$$(J_B(t_{D,M})\alpha_B)^{-1}\,b'\,(T'_C(\alpha_A)t_{C,N}).$$
It satisfies the original counit identity
$$e_{B,M_B}\circ F_B(b)=T_D(e_{A,M})\circ c^{-1}.$$
All displayed products are compositions with the rightmost factor applied first. No ambient exceptional functor or adjunction on all of $\mathcal D'_R$ is required: $Q_A$ is one object and $J_B$ is defined only on $\mathcal V_B$. The comparison $\delta$ is needed only at $N$ and on $\mathcal C^0_B$. Full faithfulness and faithfulness are needed only on the stated objects and Hom set; the coefficient functors need not preserve bounded-below objects globally.
